facts.fact: RSTP's National Data Centre offers colocation (rack space, power, connectivity), dedicated servers and cloud services to clients, per its own brochure; undated, the published date 2023-07 is used.

The operator's brochure describes the National Data Centre as a Tier-III energy-efficient facility with 99.982% uptime (operator's statement, no certification named); undated, the published date 2023-07 is used.
